summary: Iteration 8 covered profile photo (upload/serve/remove), profile rename, new settings fields (language, sunnah_reminders), Sunnah screen (Pro gated), Pro-order change (Pengingat sunah first, NOT Haji), Share composer (own-photo default full-screen + 30 captions with shuffle), Focus pill, and Hajj screen. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_profile_photo.py (default settings language='id'/sunnah_reminders=[]; PUT persists language='en'+['tahajud','dhuha']; invalid language 'fr' -> 422; POST /api/profile/photo with generated 1x1 PNG returns User.photo_path; GET /api/files/{path}?token=owner -> 200 image/*; ?token=other -> 404; DELETE /api/profile/photo nulls photo_path AND owner GET returns 404 for that path afterward (soft-delete); text/plain upload -> 422; PUT /api/profile rename persists, /api/auth/me reflects). Frontend on 390x844 with fresh guest login validated: (1) Home shows home-avatar, prayer-checkin-{subuh,zuhur,asar,magrib,isya}, home-sunnah-button; (2) Settings settings-photo-button opens native file chooser (via Playwright expect_file_chooser) — after uploading PNG, settings-photo-remove-button appears and the avatar src becomes '/api/files/...' proving expo-image is rendering the served photo; (3) settings-edit-name-button -> profile-sheet, fill profile-name-input='TEST_Tester' + profile-save-button -> settings-user-name text updates to 'TEST_Tester'; (4) settings-language-button opens language-sheet, picking language-option-en flips UI to English (page contains 'Settings') and switching to language-option-ar / -ms / -id all render without crash or console errors; (5) settings-sunnah-button opens sunnah-screen — when pro_preview off, sunnah-enable-pro-button navigates to Pro screen where pro-preview-button enables preview and back returns to sunnah; sunnah-toggle-tahajud toggles ON, tapping sunnah-card-dhuha expands to show Arabic script (0x0621-0x064A characters detected in body); (6) home-pro-banner -> Pro screen: first pro-feature testID renders label 'Pengingat salat sunah · Tahajud, Dhuha, Witir, Rawatib · nia...' (Hajj is NOT first — requirement met); (7) daily-share-button opens sheet, share-photo-mode-bg + share-photo-mode-center chips visible BEFORE picking a photo, picking via share-photo-gallery file chooser causes share-photo-full to render (photo becomes card background), 30 caption chips detected (share-caption-0..29), 0 chips contain 'viral', share-caption-shuffle button present. Focus pill (blocker-enabled-toggle with ON/OFF label) and Hajj step toggle were fully verified in iteration 7's report — this run's second attempt was blocked by a stale share sheet in the same session, so not re-verified here (should_main_agent_self_test set to true for those two flows). No React Native red screen and no console.error output during either run — only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, resizeMode, pointerEvents) which are framework-level.

react_native_issues.issue: Console prints 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on every load. These originate from RN-Web / framework code, not app business logic, but are worth an eventual sweep. Reference: any screen mount.

action_items: OPTIONAL: sweep the three RN-Web deprecation console warnings (shadow*, Image.resizeMode, pointerEvents) — replace with boxShadow, props.resizeMode, style.pointerEvents to silence noise.

OPTIONAL: consider naming Pro feature testIDs semantically (e.g., 'pro-feature-sunnah', 'pro-feature-hajj') instead of numeric indexes ('pro-feature-0') to keep tests stable if feature order ever changes. Currently numeric ordering worked for us to verify 'Pengingat sunah first' but is fragile.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile photo pipeline is well-scoped: /api/profile/photo validates MIME against IMAGE_TYPES + 6 MB cap, stores in Emergent Object Storage under 'azam-app-blocker/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.{ext}', and inserts a photos-doc with deleted_at=null so cross-user reads at /api/files/{path}?token=... correctly return 404 (verified in backend test).

GET /api/files/{path} accepts session token via ?token= query param (since cannot send Authorization header) AND falls back to Authorization: Bearer — clean dual-path with reuse of current_user helper.
DELETE /api/profile/photo soft-deletes the photos-doc via update_many(deleted_at) and nulls users.photo_path — a subsequent GET /api/files returns 404 as expected (backend test confirmed).

Settings model tightened with new Literal fields: language: 'id'|'en'|'ms'|'ar' and sunnah_reminders: list of 'tahajud'|'dhuha'|'witir'|'rawatib' capped at 4 — Pydantic rejects invalid values with the custom 422 handler flattening to a single string 'detail'.
PUT /api/profile is a slim endpoint (60-char name limit, trim, update users doc) that returns the updated User — /auth/me reflects immediately since it reads from users collection.
Frontend Pro feature ordering: source shows 'Pengingat salat sunah' has been moved to index 0 (validated at runtime — first pro-feature-* testID renders that label).
Share composer own-photo now defaults to full-screen (LayarPenuh chip active), with both share-photo-mode-bg and share-photo-mode-center chips ALWAYS visible even before a photo is picked — verified.
Caption library exactly 30 per language, screened clean of 'viral' — verified via DOM scrape.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 new iter8 + 13/13 iter7 + 8/8 iter6 = 27/27; pre-existing test_api_core has 1 unrelated check-in race failure not caused by iter8)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (10/11 review bullets fully verified; Focus pill ON/OFF label re-verification & Hajj mark-done deferred — both regressed from iter7 which passed, blocked here by an unrelated same-run share-sheet state)

seed_data_creation: All backend test data is ephemeral: each test uses a fresh POST /api/auth/guest token. Photo test builds a 1x1 PNG in-process (no /tmp write required). Frontend test clears localStorage before each run so no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend base https://9306b460-5463-4638-a0e2-20b08a7825b2.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844). Auth = POST /api/auth/guest -> Bearer session_token (30-day TTL). NEW endpoints this iteration: PUT /api/profile {name}, POST /api/profile/photo multipart file, DELETE /api/profile/photo, GET /api/files/{path}?token=<token>. Settings gains 'language' (id/en/ms/ar) and 'sunnah_reminders' (tahajud/dhuha/witir/rawatib list<=4). CRITICAL gotcha: image-picker file input on web is injected ONLY after tapping settings-photo-button / share-photo-gallery — use page.expect_file_chooser() BEFORE click, not query_selector('input[type=file]') beforehand. Pro screen feature testIDs are 'pro-feature-0','pro-feature-1',...' (numeric, order-dependent), NOT semantic — first index is now 'Pengingat salat sunah'. Sunnah screen is Pro-gated; enable pro_preview once per test session (via Pro screen pro-preview-button) before toggling sunnah items. Language switch effects are LIVE (tabs/Home/Settings/Pro/Sunnah/Focus text re-render immediately) — no reload needed. Share composer's caption chips use share-caption-{0..29}; shuffle button = share-caption-shuffle. Focus tab pill = blocker-enabled-toggle (also blocker-enabled-switch works). Hajj access via home-pro-banner -> Pro screen -> numeric pro-feature card (not pro-feature-hajj).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs discovered in iteration 8 scope. The single failing pre-existing test (test_api_core::test_checkin_duplicate_idempotent_and_undo) is unrelated to iter8 features and appears to be a check-in state race from the sequential parallel runners; safely ignored for this review.
